class.name: Box3DDistanceJoint
class.brief_description: Keeps two bodies a set distance apart: a rod, a rope, or a spring.
class.description: Constrains the distance between the joint's anchor points on the two bodies. Rigid by default (a rod), a spring with [member spring_enabled], and a rope when [member limit_enabled] lets the distance vary between [member min_length] and [member max_length]. [b][member spring_enabled] gates the rest of the joint.[/b] While it is off the joint holds [member length] rigidly and Box3D ignores the limits and the motor entirely, so a winch or a rope that "does nothing" is usually a distance joint with no spring. The scene dock warns about it.

method.name: get_current_length
method.description: The current distance between the joint's anchors, in metres, which differs from [member length] whenever the spring or the limits let it.

method.name: get_motor_force
method.description: Force the motor applied on the last step, in newtons.

method.name: get_spring_force_range
method.description: The spring force limits as a [Vector2] of (lower, upper), in newtons.

method.name: set_spring_force_range
method.description: Clamps the force the spring may apply to [param lower] .. [param upper], in newtons. Box3D leaves this unlimited by default; a one-sided range makes a spring that can pull but not push (or the reverse). Not an inspector property because the defaults are the float extremes, which no spin box can express.

members.member: Rest distance between the anchors, in metres. A negative value means "whatever the bodies are apart when the joint is created", which is usually what you want when authoring in the editor.

Clamps the distance to [member min_length] .. [member max_length]. Requires [member spring_enabled]: a rigid distance joint has no slack for a limit to act on. Together they give a rope that can go slack but not stretch past its length.
Longest allowed distance, in metres, while [member limit_enabled] is on.
Force budget for the motor, in newtons. Box3D clamps the motor's impulse to this times the step, so at 0 the winch pulls nothing. The scene dock warns when the motor is on and this is 0.
Shortest allowed distance, in metres, while [member limit_enabled] is on.
Drives the distance between the bodies toward [member motor_speed] -- a winch. Requires [member spring_enabled]: with the joint rigid at [member length], Box3D never runs the motor.
Target rate of change of the distance, in metres per second. Positive lengthens.
Damping ratio of the spring, non-dimensional. 1.0 is critical damping (no overshoot); below 1 the joint oscillates. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.
Makes the joint soft: instead of holding [member length] exactly it pulls toward it like a spring.
Stiffness of the spring, in cycles per second. Higher is stiffer. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.
